title: OpenAI e o limite da autonomia: quando um agente precisa parar
event_or_case: OpenAI developing automated shutdown capabilities for autonomous AI systems after a safety-test incident
management_thesis: Autonomy should be deployed only with explicit permission ceilings, monitored actions, escalation ownership and stop conditions.

scenes_json.cta: Na sua empresa, quem decide quando uma IA precisa parar?

music_profile.mood: modern intelligent tension, controlled technology pulse, cinematic but restrained

visual_rules: Use rights-cleared real technology, AI-agent, cybersecurity, monitoring and governance context.
Do not fabricate footage of the reported safety-test incident.
Do not show a fake OpenAI interface, fake breach screen, fake lawmaker quote or fabricated company statement.
If OpenAI branding is used, use only rights-cleared editorial context and keep it factual.
Every scene must visually match the narration and use distinct assets.
No flash cuts, excessive zoom, static image held too long or sensational hacker imagery.
